# FullBright

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** Fullbright, FullBright, Light

## What it does

FullBright removes the darkness from the game world, letting you see clearly in caves, dungeons, deep water, and at night without torches, potions, or other light sources. It's handy for exploring, mining, and spotting players or mobs hiding in the shadows.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/fullbright). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
